| -- FUNCTION public.qb_managed_learner_provision<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.qb_managed_learner_provision(p_teacher uuid, p_class uuid, p_user uuid, p_first_name text, p_username text, p_consent_ref text)<br> RETURNS jsonb<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br> SET search_path TO ''<br>AS $function$<br>declare c public.classes; t public.profiles; first text := btrim(coalesce(p_first_name, '')); sp public.student_profiles; grade_code text; mkt uuid; country text;<br>begin<br>  select * into c from public.classes where id = p_class;<br>  select * into t from public.profiles where id = p_teacher;<br>  if c.id is null or t.id is null or lower(c.status::text) <> 'active' or c.teacher_user_id <> p_teacher then raise exception 'QB_CLASS_NOT_MANAGED' using errcode = '42501'; end if;<br>  if char_length(first) not between 2 and 40 or first !~ '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z '' -]*$' then raise exception 'QB_MANAGED_NAME_INVALID'; end if;<br>  if p_username !~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9.]{3,30}$' then raise exception 'QB_MANAGED_USERNAME_INVALID'; end if;<br>  if char_length(btrim(coalesce(p_consent_ref, ''))) < 5 then raise exception 'QB_MANAGED_CONSENT_REQUIRED'; end if;<br>  if not exists (select 1 from auth.users where id = p_user) then raise exception 'AUTH_REQUIRED'; end if;<br>  grade_code := c.grade::text; mkt := coalesce(t.primary_market_id, t.default_market_id); country := t.country;<br>  -- the sign-in trigger may already have made a basic profile; make it the managed learner's profile<br>  insert into public.profiles(id, role, full_name, email, status, country, school_name, default_market_id, primary_market_id, onboarding_completed_at)<br>  values (p_user, 'student', first, (select email from auth.users where id = p_user), 'active', coalesce(country, 'Ghana'), c.school_name, mkt, mkt, now())<br>  on conflict (id) do update set role = 'student', full_name = excluded.full_name, status = 'active', country = excluded.country, school_name = excluded.school_name,<br>      default_market_id = excluded.default_market_id, primary_market_id = excluded.primary_market_id, onboarding_completed_at = excluded.onboarding_completed_at;<br>  insert into public.student_profiles(user_id, grade, school_name, country, status, managed_by, is_minor)<br>  values (p_user, c.grade, c.school_name, coalesce(country, 'Ghana'), 'active', p_teacher, true)<br>  on conflict (user_id) do update set grade = excluded.grade, school_name = excluded.school_name, status = 'active', managed_by = excluded.managed_by, is_minor = true, archived_at = null<br>  returning * into sp;<br>  if mkt is not null then insert into public.user_market_memberships(user_id, market_id, active) values (p_user, mkt, true) on conflict (user_id, market_id) do update set active = true; end if;<br>  insert into public.class_memberships(class_id, student_id, student_user_id, student_email, student_name, grade, | -- FUNCTION public.qb_settle_paid_order<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.qb_settle_paid_order(p_order_id uuid)<br> RETURNS jsonb<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br> SET search_path TO 'public'<br>AS $function$<br>declare<br>    v_order public.orders%rowtype;<br>    v_item record;<br><br>    v_rate numeric := 0;<br>    v_fee numeric(14,2);<br>    v_net numeric(14,2);<br><br>    v_entitlements integer := 0;<br>    v_earnings integer := 0;<br>begin<br><br>    if not (<br>        public.qb_is_platform_admin()<br>        or public.qb_has_permission('FINANCE_MANAGE')<br>    ) then<br>        raise exception 'QB_PERMISSION_DENIED';<br>    end if;<br><br><br>    select *<br>    into v_order<br>    from public.orders<br>    where id = p_order_id<br>    for update;<br><br><br>    if not found then<br>        raise exception 'QB_ORDER_NOT_FOUND';<br>    end if;<br><br><br>    -- Idempotency.<br>    if upper(v_order.fulfillment_status) = 'FULFILLED' then<br><br>        return jsonb_build_object(<br>            'status','PASS',<br>            'idempotent',true,<br>            'order_id',p_order_id<br>        );<br><br>    end if;<br><br><br>    /*<br>     * This RPC assumes the trusted payment layer has verified<br>     * receipt of funds before calling it.<br>     */<br><br>    update public.orders<br>    set<br>        payment_status = 'PAID'<br>    where id = p_order_id;<br><br><br>    for v_item in<br><br>        select<br>            oi.*,<br>            mp.product_type,<br>            mp.tenant_id<br>        from public.order_items oi<br>        join public.marketplace_products mp<br>          on mp.id = oi.product_id<br>        where oi.order_id = p_order_id<br><br>    loop<br><br>        -- ----------------------------------------------------<br>        -- COMMISSION<br>        -- seller-specific rule first<br>        -- then generic product-type rule<br>        -- ----------------------------------------------------<br><br>        select coalesce(cr.platform_fee_rate,0)<br>        into v_rate<br>        from public.commission_rules cr<br>        where upper(cr.status) = 'ACTIVE'<br>          and (<br>              cr.starts_at is null<br>              or cr.starts_at <= now()<br>          )<br>          and (<br>              cr.ends_at is null<br>              or cr.ends_at > now()<br>          )<br>          and (<br>              cr.seller_id = v_item.seller_id<br>              or cr.seller_id is null<br>          )<br>          and (<br>              cr.product_type = v_item.product_type<br>              or cr.product_type is null<br>          )<br>        order by<br>            case<br>                when cr.seller_id = v_item.seller_id<br>                    then 0<br>                else 1<br>            end,<br>            case<br>                when cr.product_type = v_item.product_type<br>                    then 0<br>                else 1<br>            end<br>        limit 1;<br><br><br>        /*<br>         * Supports either:<br>         * 0.20 = 20%<br>         * or<br>         * 20 = 20%<br>         */<br>        if coalesce(v_rate,0) > 1 then<br>            v_rate := v_rate / 100;<br>        end if;<br><br><br>        v_rate :=<br>            greatest(<br>                least(<br>                    coalesce(v_rate,0),<br>                    1<br>                ),<br>                0<br>            );<br><br><br>        v_fee :=<br>            round(<br>                v_item.line_total * v_rate,<br>                2<br>            );<br><br><br>        v_net :=<br>            v_item.line_total - v_fee;<br><br><br>        -- ----------------------------------------------------<br>        -- SELLER EARNING<br>        -- ----------------------------------------------------<br><br>        if not exists (<br>            select 1<br>            from public.seller_earnings se<br>            where se.order_item_id = v_item.id<br>        ) then<br><br>            insert into public.seller_earnings(<br>                seller_id,<br>                order_item_id,<br>                currency,<br>                gross_amount,<br>                platform_fee,<br>                seller_net_amount,<br>                earning_status,<br>                available_at<br>            )<br>            values(<br>                v_item.seller_id,<br>                v_item.id,<br>                v_order.currency,<br>                v_item.line_total,<br>                v_fee,<br>                v_net,<br>                'AVAILABLE',<br>                now()<br>            );<br><br>            v_earnings := v_earnings + 1;<br><br>        end if;<br><br><br>        -- ----------------------------------------------------<br>        -- BUYER ENTITLEMENT<br>        -- ----------------------------------------------------<br><br>        if not exists (<br>            select 1<br>            from public.entitlements e<br>            where e.beneficiary_user_id =<br>                    v_order.buyer_user_id<br>              and e.source_type =<br>                    'ORDER_ITEM'<br>              and e.source_id =<br>                    v_item.id<br>        ) then<br><br>            insert into public.entitlements(<br>                beneficiary_user_id,<br>                source_type,<br>                source_id,<br>                entitlement_type,<br>                scope,<br>                starts_at,<br>                status,<br>                product_id,<br>                order_item_id<br>            )<br>            values(<br>                v_order.buyer_user_id,<br>                'ORDER_ITEM',<br>                v_item.id,<br>                'MARKETPLACE_PRODUCT',<br>                jsonb_build_object(<br>                    'product_id',v_item.product_id,<br>                    'product_type',v_item.product_type,<br>                    'quantity',v_item.quantity<br>                ),<br>                now(),<br>                'ACTIVE',<br>                v_item.product_id,<br>                v_item.id<br>            );<br><br>            v_entitlements :=<br>                v_entitlements + 1;<br><br>        end if;<br><br>    end loop;<br><br><br>    update public.orders<br>    set<br>        payment_status = 'PAID',<br>        fulfillment_status = 'FULFILLED',<br>        status = 'COMPLETED'<br>    where id = p_order_id;<br><br><br>    insert into public.analytics_events(<br>        tenant_id,<br>        user_id,<br>        event_name,<br>        entity_type,<br>        entity_id,<br>        properties<br>    )<br>    values(<br>        v_order.tenant_id,<br>        v_order.buyer_user_id,<br>        'MARKETPLACE_ORDER_FULFILLED',<br>        'ORDER',<br>        p_order_id,<br>        jsonb_build_object(<br>            'amount',v_order.total_amount,<br>            'currency',v_order.currency,<br>            'entitlements_created',v_entitlements,<br>            'seller_earnings_created',v_earnings<br>        )<br>    );<br><br><br>    return jsonb_build_object(<br>        'status','PASS',<br>        'idempotent',false,<br>        'order_id',p_order_id,<br>        'payment_status','PAID',<br>        'fulfillment_status','FULFILLED',<br>        'entitlements_created',v_entitlements,<br>        'seller_earnings_created',v_earnings<br>    );<br><br>end;<br>$function$<br>; | -- FUNCTION quizbox_competition.dispatch_review_bridge<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION quizbox_competition.dispatch_review_bridge(p_action text, p_sponsor uuid, p_data jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)<br> RETURNS jsonb<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br> SET search_path TO ''<br>AS $function$<br>declare c uuid; end if;<br>  if p_action='review_detail' then<br>   result:=public.qb_sme_review_detail(work.id);<br>   if work.review_completed_at is null then update quizbox_competition.candidates set status='UNDER_REVIEW',updated_at=now() where id=item.id; end if;<br>   return result\|\|jsonb_build_object('candidate_id',item.id);<br>  end if;<br>  return public.qb_sme_complete_review(work.id,p_data->>'decision',p_data->>'note',(p_data->>'human_reviewed')::boolean,(p_data->>'version')::integer);<br> end if;<br> if p_action='oversight' then<br>  if not quizbox_market.is_super() then raise exception 'SUPER_ADMIN_REQUIRED' using errcode='42501'; | -- FUNCTION quizbox_private.core_qb_submit_attempt<br>CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION quizbox_private.core_qb_submit_attempt(p_attempt_id uuid, p_submission_reason text DEFAULT 'student_submit'::text)<br> RETURNS jsonb<br> LANGUAGE plpgsql<br> SECURITY DEFINER<br> SET search_path TO 'public'<br>AS $function$<br>declare<br>    v_attempt public.attempts%rowtype;<br>    v_assessment public.assessments%rowtype;<br><br>    v_student_id uuid;<br><br>    v_result_id uuid;<br><br>    v_question_count integer := 0;<br>    v_answered_count integer := 0;<br>    v_correct_count integer := 0;<br>    v_incorrect_count integer := 0;<br>    v_unanswered_count integer := 0;<br><br>    v_score numeric := 0;<br>    v_total_marks numeric := 0;<br>    v_percentage numeric := 0;<br><br>    v_passed boolean := false;<br><br>    rec record;<br>    v_correct boolean;<br><br>begin<br> <br> if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'QB_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED'; end if;<br><br>    v_student_id :=<br>        public.qb_current_student_id();<br><br><br>    select *<br>    into v_attempt<br>    from public.attempts<br>    where id = p_attempt_id<br>    for update;<br><br><br>    if not found then<br>        raise exception 'QB_ATTEMPT_NOT_FOUND';<br>    end if;<br><br><br>    if v_attempt.student_id is distinct from v_student_id<br>       and not public.qb_is_platform_admin()<br>    then<br>        raise exception 'QB_ATTEMPT_OWNERSHIP_DENIED';<br>    end if;<br><br><br>    if v_attempt.status::text in (<br>        'submitted',<br>        'auto_submitted',<br>        'completed'<br>    ) then<br><br>        select id<br>        into v_result_id<br>        from public.assessment_results<br>        where attempt_id = p_attempt_id;<br><br>        return jsonb_build_object(<br>            'status','PASS',<br>            'idempotent',true,<br>            'result_id',v_result_id<br>        );<br><br>    end if;<br><br><br>    if v_attempt.status <> 'in_progress' then<br>        raise exception 'QB_ATTEMPT_NOT_SUBMITTABLE';<br>    end if;<br><br><br>    select *<br>    into v_assessment<br>    from public.assessments<br>    where id = v_attempt.assessment_id;<br><br><br>    for rec in<br><br>        select<br>            aq.question_id,<br>            aq.answer_type_snapshot,<br>            aq.correct_answer_snapshot,<br>            aq.answer_spec_snapshot,<br>            coalesce(aq.marks_snapshot,1) as marks,<br><br>            r.id as response_id,<br>            r.selected_answer,<br>            r.selected_value<br><br>        from public.assessment_questions aq<br><br>        left join public.responses r<br>          on r.attempt_id = p_attempt_id<br>         and r.question_id = aq.question_id<br><br>        where aq.assessment_id =<br>            v_attempt.assessment_id<br><br>        order by aq.question_order<br><br>    loop<br><br>        v_question_count :=<br>            v_question_count + 1;<br><br>        v_total_marks :=<br>            v_total_marks +<br>            rec.marks;<br><br><br>        if rec.response_id is null<br>           or (<br>               nullif(<br>                   trim(<br>                       coalesce(<br>                           rec.selected_answer,<br>                           ''<br>                       )<br>                   ),<br>                   ''<br>               ) is null<br>               and rec.selected_value is null<br>           )<br>        then<br><br>            v_unanswered_count :=<br>                v_unanswered_count + 1;<br><br>            continue;<br><br>        end if;<br><br><br>        v_answered_count :=<br>            v_answered_count + 1;<br><br><br>        v_correct :=<br>            public.qb_grade_response(<br>                rec.answer_type_snapshot,<br>                rec.correct_answer_snapshot,<br>                rec.answer_spec_snapshot,<br>                rec.selected_answer,<br>                rec.selected_value<br>            );<br><br><br>        if v_correct then<br><br>            v_correct_count :=<br>                v_correct_count + 1;<br><br>            v_score :=<br>                v_score + rec.marks;<br><br>        else<br><br>            v_incorrect_count :=<br>                v_incorrect_count + 1;<br><br>        end if;<br><br><br>        update public.responses<br>        set<br>            correct_answer =<br>                rec.correct_answer_snapshot,<br><br>            is_correct =<br>                v_correct,<br><br>            marks_awarded =<br>                case<br>                    when v_correct<br>                    then rec.marks<br>                    else 0<br>                end,<br><br>            finalized_at =<br>                now(),<br><br>            status =<br>                'finalized'<br><br>        where id =<br>            rec.response_id;<br><br>    end loop;<br><br><br>    if              2<br>            );<br><br>    end if;<br><br><br>    v_passed :=<br>        v_percentage >=<br>        coalesce(<br>            v_attempt.pass_percent,<br>            v_assessment.pass_percent,<br>            50<br>        );<br><br><br>    insert into public.assessment_results (<br>        attempt_id,<br>        assessment_id,<br><br>        assignment_id,<br>        class_id,<br><br>        tenant_id,<br><br>        student_id,<br>        student_user_id,<br><br>        subject_code,<br>        grade,<br><br>        question_count,<br><br>        answered_count,<br>        correct_count,<br>        incorrect_count,<br>        unanswered_count,<br><br>        score,<br>        total_marks,<br><br>        percentage,<br><br>  v_attempt.assessment_id,<br><br>        v_attempt.assignment_id,<br>        v_attempt.class_id,<br><br>        v_attempt.tenant_id,<br><br>        v_attempt.student_id,<br> v_correct_count,<br>        v_incorrect_count,<br>        v_unanswered_count,<br><br>        v_score,<br>        v_total_marks,<br><br>        v_percentage,<br><br>        coalesce(<br>            v_attempt.pass_percent,<br>            v_assessment.pass_percent,<br>            50<br>        ),<br><br>        v_passed,<br><br>        v_attempt.started_at,<br>        now(),<br><br>        p_submission_reason,<br><br>        'final'<br>    )<br><br>    on conflict(attempt_id)<br>    do update<br>    set<br>        answered_count =<br>            excluded.answered_count,<br><br>        correct_count =<br>            excluded.correct_count,<br><br>        incorrect_count =<br>            excluded.incorrect_count,<br><br>        unanswered_count =<br>            excluded.unanswered_count,<br><br>        score =<br>            excluded.score,<br><br>        total_marks =<br>            excluded.total_marks,<br><br>        percentage =<br>            excluded.percentage,<br><br>        passed =<br>            excluded.passed,<br><br>        submitted_at =<br>            excluded.submitted_at<br><br>    returning id<br>    into v_result_id;<br><br><br>    update public.attempts<br>    set<br>        submitted_at =<br>            now(),<br><br>        score =<br>            v_score,<br><br>        total_marks =<br>            v_total_marks,<br><br>        percentage =<br>            v_percentage,<br><br>        answered_count =<br>            v_answered_count,<br><br>        correct_count =<br>            v_correct_count,<br><br>        incorrect_count =<br>            v_incorrect_count,<br><br>        unanswered_count =<br>            v_unanswered_count,<br><br>        passed =<br>            v_passed,<br><br>        submission_reason =<br>            p_submission_reason,<br><br>        last_activity_at =<br>            now()<br><br>    where id = p_attempt_id;<br><br><br>    /*<br>     * Existing attempt_status enum values are preserved.<br>     * We use whatever submitted/completed label exists.<br>     */<br><br>    if exists (<br>        select 1<br>        from pg_enum e<br>    set status = 'submitted'<br>        where id = p_attempt_id;<br><br>    elsif exists (<br>        select 1<br>        from pg_enum e<br>        join pg_type t<br>          on t.oid = where id = p_attempt_id;<br><br>    end if;<br><br><br>    -- Classroom gradebook write.<br><br>    if v_attempt.assignment_id is not null<br>       and v_attempt.class_id is not null<br>        student_id,<br>            student_user_id,<br><br>            student_email,<br>            student_name,<br><br>            score,<br>            total_marks,<br>            percentage,<br><br>            status,<br>            graded_at<br>        )<br><br>        select<br>            v_result_id,<br>            v_attempt.assessment_id,<br>            v_attempt.id,<br>            v_attempt.assignment_id,<br>            v_attempt.class_id,<br><br>            sp.id,<br>            sp.user_id,<br><br>            p.email,<br>            p.full_name,<br><br>            v_score,<br>            v_total_marks,<br>            v_percentage,<br><br>            'final',<br>            now()<br><br>        from public.student_profiles sp<br>        join public.profiles v_score,<br><br>        'total_marks',<br>            v_total_marks,<br><br>        'percentage',<br>            v_percentage,<br><br>        'correct_count',<br>            v_correct_count,<br><br>        'incorrect_count',<br>            v_incorrect_count,<br><br>        'unanswered_count',<br>            v_unanswered_count,<br><br>        'passed',<br>            v_passed<br>
